transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

Well... I'm mostly here because everybody keeps acting like I'm just imagining things. But I know what's going on. 

I know my wife's relative has been coming into this house to get at me. I mean... I know where I leave my things. My tools don't just move themselves. And every weekend, my fishing plans get spoiled, and it's not by accident. 

It's been months of this. It's plain as day to me that he's been trying to take over my place and... push me out. But like I said, everyone just thinks I'm making it up.
Have you ever heard voices, sounds, or whispering when no one was around?
No. ...I don't hear voices. Nothing like that.
Aside from feeling frustrated by this situation, have you been feeling persistently down or depressed?
No. ...I'm not depressed. Just... tired of dealing with it all. But no. Nothing like that.
Have you had any significant medical illnesses or head injuries recently?
No. ...I haven't been sick. My head is fine. Haven't had any accidents or anything like that. I'm healthy.
Have you ever felt like thoughts were being put into your head by an outside force?
No. ...I don't know what you mean by that. My thoughts are my own. Nobody's putting anything in my head.
